description: B2'S PLAIN SLAB (SLAB; docs/reference-parts/buildings.md B8 'Edge off', docs/BACKLOG.md SLAB): ONE loft.slab 1.0.0 on a typed 144 x 120 in rectangle from the origin, 4 in thick, its top at Z 0, the thickened edge off. One body, concrete (2400 kg/m^3), its metadata the pour (5% waste allowance) and no rebar. model.json is EXACTLY the expansion with its member material; members.json is the body's member metadata with its plugin (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_slab.py pins both); services/geometry/tests/test_slab_b8.py checks the cut list (1.48 yd^3 net, 1.75 ordered) and these numbers against a build123d box.
derivation: Every expectation is ANALYTIC (x 25.4 = mm exactly), never recorded from the plugin or the kernel.
centroid = (72, 60, -2) in = (1828.8, 1524, -50.8) mm by symmetry; the centre of mass is the same (one material).
topology: one box: 6 faces, 12 edges, 1 shell. MESH: 24 vertices and 12 triangles (2 per planar quad, no shared vertices).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill): the kernel's volume is 1 132 673 863.6799998 mm^3, one ULP (2.4e-7) below the exact decimal, because x 25.4 is not exact in binary; the area, bounds and centroid are within 2.3e-13. 1e-6 is 4 ULPs of a 1.1e9 mm^3 value; the slab 1/16 in thinner changes the volume by 1.8e7 mm^3.
